parameters.boundary_policy: observation-only scalar reflection of the predicted position; the inverse of the same public map applied to the update target so the learner regresses in the coordinate its own linear law lives in; and no update on a window whose displacement feature straddles a wall, detected from the learner's own previous raw prediction having needed reflection. All three are programmed public knowledge of the observation format, not learned capability, and none uses an evaluator bounce label.
